thread:
maya.zh: heads up — prod uploads started failing a few mins ago with KMS AccessDenied when S3 tries to decrypt the data key. error: "AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt". Anyone seen this pattern after a key rotation?
liam.c: can you paste the CloudTrail decrypt event?
maya.zh: here's the relevant CloudTrail entry (sanitized):
```
EventName: Decrypt
UserIdentity: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/ingest-uploader/ingest-app-20260320
ErrorCode: AccessDenied
KmsKeyId: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
```
irina: hmm the assumed-role session name has a timestamp suffix now — did the CI change how it calls AssumeRole?
alex-g: also check the CMK key policy — if it has a Condition on aws:PrincipalArn == the exact assumed-role ARN it will break when the session name changes.
maya.zh: we do have a weird condition in the key policy, looks like someone locked it down to the assumed-role arn string. snippet:
```json
{
  "Sid": "AllowIngestRole",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "*"},
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "*",
  "Condition": {
    "StringEquals": {"aws:PrincipalArn": "arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/ingest-uploader/ingest-app"}
  }
}
```
liam.c: oh yep that's the culprit — that Condition matches only the exact assumed-role ARN without the timestamp suffix. when AssumeRole creates a session it appends the session name (we started including build-id in the session name in the new deploy flow).
irina: two options: 1) change the key policy Principal to the role ARN (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ingest-uploader) which matches regardless of session name, or 2) relax the condition to an ArnLike with wildcard for the assumed-role session suffix.
alex-g: or create a grant for the role with CreateGrant so we avoid brittle Principal/Condition collisions. grants survive rotations better for short-term access patterns.
maya.zh: copying recommended quick fix — updating condition to ArnLike: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/ingest-uploader/* and reapply. will test on staging first.
deploy-bot: deploy started: update/keypolicy-allow-ingest-role (will notify on success) :rocket:
liam.c: also double-check there aren't separate IAM policies explicitly denying kms:Decrypt for the role in the account boundary — less likely but worth sanity check.
maya.zh: tested in staging — worked. applying to prod in 5. will monitor CloudTrail and S3 errors.
ops-bot: alert suppressed for key/abcd-ef01 until 2350123600 per maya.zh request.
maya.zh: prod patch applied. uploads resumed, no more AccessDenied on Decrypt. thanks all :tada: — followup: I'll open a short runbook note about not using exact assumed-role ARN in key policies.
irina: nice catch. can we add an automation test that simulates AssumeRole with varying session names against the policy?
alex-g: yes, small integration test in our kms-test harness would be quick. I'll add a ticket.
liam.c: marking resolved from security side.
maya.zh: closing thread in 10m unless anyone objects.
